subject: Request: Multipoint switchover probationary window and RTO/RPO carveout
messages:
From: Simon Reed <simon.reed@finledger.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multipoint switchover — probationary window & RTO ask

Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We drilled into the failover behavior and the multi-region warm standby. Two asks from our ops/security teams: 1) can Redwood offer a 90-day probationary window post-go-live where we run with a relaxed penalty for RTO/RPO misses as we tune prefix caching and routing policies, and 2) we need a short-term RTO carveout during the initial switchover period — specifically an agreed activation lead time of up to 10 minutes for cross-region switchover for the first 30 days while we validate runbooks.

We understand production SLAs are firm; this is to avoid triggering penalties from our internal auditors while we stabilize. Happy to sign a documented mutual action plan (MAP) and pay a small additional onboarding fee if needed.

Can you confirm feasibility and who on Redwood we should loop in for MAP and SRE coordination?

Best,
Simon
Simon Reed
Head of Infra Ops, FinLedger
[Attachment: initial_failover_questions.txt (text)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Reed <simon.reed@finledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multipoint switchover — probationary window & RTO ask

Simon — thanks for laying this out. Short answer: we can offer a structured probationary period with clear gates, but we need to align on the monitoring signals, acceptance criteria, and temporary SLA adjustments. I've looped in Marissa (product ops) and Jonas (legal) to scope the MAP and the legal carveout.

Proposed next steps: 
- Redwood to produce a MAP draft that specifies the probationary window length, SLO targets during the window, instrumentation checkpoints, and rollback criteria.
- Engineering runbook proof-of-concept: technical checklist for switchover (KV cache warmup, routing fallback rules).
- A short fee schedule for extended support during the probationary window.

I'll follow up with a MAP draft by Friday. If there are any non-negotiable items on your side (e.g., auditor language), flag them in reply.

— Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Multipoint switchover — probationary window & RTO ask

Chloe / team — drafting engineer/ops constraints here. Important technical points to include in the MAP: 
1) For the first 30 days post-cutover we recommend an "activation lead" allowance of up to 10 minutes for cross-region switchover for large sessions (>100k tokens) while KV cache stabilization completes. For smaller sessions the effective switchover latency will typically be under 90s; the 10-minute window is a conservative bound.
2) RPO: we can guarantee <5min replication lag for user metadata, but for ephemeral KV cache we cannot promise zero-loss during active sessions; propose an RPO carveout for in-flight KV content during the probationary window.
3) Monitoring: require FinLedger to onboard two synthetic scenarios and provide runbook run results to Redwood daily for the probationary period.
4) Penalties: propose a waiver for SLA financial credits for the probationary window provided the MAP checkpoints are met; if checkpoints fail for 3 consecutive days we revert to standard SLA and potential credits.

I'll attach a first-pass MAP and a DR timeline spreadsheet. Can someone from legal review the wording around "waiver" vs "temporary adjustment"?

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: FinLedger_MAP_v2.pdf, DR_Timeline_Spreadsheet.xlsx]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multipoint switchover — probationary window & RTO ask

Team — from a legal/commercial perspective we need to be careful with language. "Waiver" can imply permanent concession; prefer "conditional temporary adjustment" with specific acceptance gates. Key points I will require in the MAP draft: 
- Explicit start/end dates for the probationary window (e.g., 30/60/90 days options).
- Objective pass/fail criteria for daily checkpoints (synthetic test pass rate >= 99%, error budget thresholds).
- Escalation and termination clauses: if FinLedger requests an emergency rollback or we detect systemic instability, Redwood reserves right to terminate the probationary facility and revert to standard SLA.
- Financial handling: onboarding fee and additional monitoring retainer must be documented as non-refundable.

I'll mark up Marissa's MAP and return comments by COB tomorrow.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_markups.docx (docx)]

From: Simon Reed <simon.reed@finledger.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Support Team <support@finledger.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multipoint switchover — probationary window & RTO ask

Chloe — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from FinLedger: 
- We would prefer a 60-day probationary window (rather than 30) given the scale of traffic and compliance audits.
- Acceptance checkpoints: synthetic test pass rate target of >= 99.5% sounds reasonable.
- We are willing to pay an onboarding retainer and will sign the MAP if it includes a clause that prevents SLA credits from retroactively applying during the probationary window (i.e., no retro-credit triggers).

Can you confirm Redwood's position on the 60 days and the non-retro credits clause? If acceptable, we'll route the MAP to our legal team for a quick review.

Thanks,
Simon

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Reed <simon.reed@finledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Multipoint switchover — probationary window & RTO ask

Simon — thanks, and good questions. Short answers: 
- Redwood is prepared to support a 60-day probationary window as a conditional temporary adjustment, provided the MAP checkpoints are instrumented and FinLedger runs the two synthetic scenarios daily.
- We will include explicit language that credits for SLA violations will not be applied retroactively for events occurring during the probationary window, with the caveat that if Redwood teams fail to meet agreed operational obligations (e.g., missed runbook response SLAs), we will discuss remediation outside the credit mechanism.
- Financials: proposed onboarding retainer = $18,000 (covers SRE on-call for probationary window + MAP operationalization).

Next steps: Marissa will produce the MAP doc (incorporating Jonas's legal language) and I'll send to you by EOD. If FinLedger legal needs a redline, please route it back to Jonas and me.

Looking forward — Chloe
Chloe Martin
